def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return a permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed."""
    pre seed >= 0
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex shuffled([], 7) == []
    ex shuffled([4], 1) == [4]
    ex sorted(shuffled([1, 2, 3], 5)) == [1, 2, 3]
    ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 5) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 5)
    res = xs.copy()
    state = seed % 2147483648
    i = res.len() - 1
    while i > 0:
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
        j = state % (i + 1)
        tmp = res[i]
        res[i] = res[j]
        res[j] = tmp
        i -= 1
    return res
